articles.title: Mankind Pharma’s Rx for success: Aatmanirbhar push, affordable care
articles.summary: Ramesh and Rajeev Juneja, brothers and founders of Mankind Pharma, have successfully built one of India's top pharmaceutical companies. Their notable growth is characterized by a distinct mass-market focus, aiming to make medicines accessible to a broader population. This entrepreneurial journey highlights significant achievements in the national healthcare sector, establishing Mankind Pharma as a leading player in the industry.

articles.title: India-China energy cooperation doesn't require warm relations, or lofty civilisational rhetoric
articles.summary: In 2015, then-Indian Defence Minister Manohar Parrikar made a subtle diplomatic observation, remarking that the eyes of Ganesh statues gifted to him seemed to grow 'narrower' annually. This anecdote, originating from Beijing, served as a humorous yet pointed commentary on India's perceptions, likely towards China, regarding evolving geopolitical or cultural dynamics, reflecting a form of strategic communication from a top defence official.

articles.title: "Hamas has ties with Lashkar-e-Taiba": Israel urges India to designate Palestine group as terror organisation
articles.summary: Israel's Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar emphasized the significant deepening of bilateral ties between Israel and India, noting positive trends in their strengthening relationship. This highlights the growing strategic partnership between New Delhi and Jerusalem, crucial for regional stability and mutual interests, often encompassing cooperation in defence, technology, and trade, vital for both nations' security and economic growth.

articles.title: First responder: Navy executes high-stakes medevac for oil rig worker deep in Arabian Sea
articles.summary: The Indian Navy executed a high-stakes medical evacuation (medevac) for an oil rig worker deep in the Arabian Sea. This swift "first responder" operation highlights the Navy's crucial operational readiness and commitment to national service. Such humanitarian missions underscore the armed forces' vital role in maritime safety and saving lives in challenging environments, showcasing their diverse responsibilities beyond traditional defence.

articles.title: RGU joins hands with Indian Navy, rolls out full scholarships for martyrs’ families
articles.summary: Assam Royal Global University (RGU) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to integrate education with a strong sense of national duty. This initiative aims to instill patriotic values and prepare students for roles of national service, aligning academic pursuits with the broader responsibilities of citizenship and national security, likely fostering future leaders for various uniformed services.
